av. johnny & ciss larkin sun 1st 11.30am av. thomas gregory recently deceased catherine (kitty) hickey; richard (dickie) kieran; joseph markey; seamus walker; anthony ruane snr the commemoration of all the faithful departed (all souls’ day): monday november 2nd - mass will be celebrated at 10am and 7.30pm in st. brigid’s church, dunleer. annual mass of remembrance: for our parish will be celebrated in st. brigid’s church, dunleer on friday november 27th at 7.30pm. the sacraments of the anointing of the sick & confessions: will be celebrated after the 10am and the 7.30pm masses on saturday october 31st in st. brigid’s church, dunleer. parish list of the dead: lists & envelopes are now available in our churches & parish office. these can be returned via the mass collection, to the sacristy or to the parochial house ideally by friday october 30th. mass is celebrated on each first friday throughout the year for all those on the parish list of the dead. there is no requirement to include a monetary donation in the envelopes. plenary indulgences in november: by long tradition, plenary indulgences for the souls of the departed may be gained in november as follows: from 12 noon on 1st november until midnight on 2nd november by visiting a church or oratory and there praying one our father and the apostle’s creed, one plenary indulgence, applicable only to the holy souls, may be gained, by all those who: have confessed (at any time within the week preceding or the week following 1st november) received holy communion (any day from 1-8 nov) prayed for the pope’s intentions (one our father and hail mary or any other prayer of one’s choice) from 1st — 8th november the faithful who visit a cemetery and pray for the dead may gain one plenary indulgence, applicable only to the holy souls. the above conditions regarding confession, holy communion and prayer for the pope’s intentions apply also for this. parish collections : last weekend – parish € 1,440 ; dues € 285; mission sunday € 230. sincere thanks for your ongoing support. chy tax relief forms: are being been posted out in these weeks. these are a valuable source of income for the parish. thank you to all those who complete and return their forms. blessing and celebration of the mural of st. brigid (side of centra): 12.30pm on sunday november 1st (all saints’ day) rosary in november: for the holy souls in purgatory, the rosary will be prayed in mosstown cemetery on saturdays in november at 3pm. the rosary will also be prayed in st. brigid’s church at 6.30pm each tuesday in november. it continues to be prayed before each morning mass. dunleer

anniversary of the dedication of church : saturday next (31st) marks the 72nd anniversary of the dedication and opening of our parish church. this is an opportunity to remember and pray for those whose vision brought it about & those whose lives have made it a centre of prayer and faith across the decades; and also, to pray that we, as a faith community, may continue to make our parish a living temple of praise to the glory of god. lately deceased: kevin o’neill , loretto park. mass intentions: saturday 24th 6.15pm joanne larkin sunday 25th 10.30am priest’s intentions sunday 25th 12noon eileen mcgregor; mission sunday £984 & € 75 (env: £ 670 & €20 ; loose plate £314 & €55). thank you for your continued support. plenary indulgence (applicable only to the dead) can be gained (once only) by all who have confessed, received communion and prayed for the pope’s intentions (our father & hail mary or prayer of choice), by visiting a church between 12noon on 1st november and midnight on 2nd november, and reciting the our father and the creed. confession can be made at any time in the week before or after 1st november. the same indulgence can be gained once per day , from 1st to 8th november, by visiting a cemetery and praying for the dead. altar society: group dare responsible in november dead list: will be available at the doors of the church from this weekend. these should be returned via the box provided at the back of the church. please note it is not necessary to include a donation but, as some people choose to do so, parishioners are asked not to leave returned dead lists in the church outside of mass times. names for the november dead list can also be emailed to the parish office. mass will be celebrated on each first friday for all those on the list. evora hospice : would like to sincerely thank the parishioners and volunteers of middle killeavy for their generosity in this year’s recent church collection , which raised £853.44 & €42.10. your support will enable the hospice to continue to provide care & support to local people and their families, and is truly appreciated. evora hospice memory tree: remember someone special by dedicating a light on the evora hospice memory tree. your dedication is a meaningful way to remember a loved one while supporting the care provided by evora hospice. for more information, please visit the evora hospice website or contact our

. thank you for your continued support. bethany house of prayer: weekly monday night prayer meeting, 8pm – 9.30 pm. all welcome (34 point road, dundalk) the legion of mary needs you: the legion of mary is a catholic lay association. it’s object is the glory of god. fruits of membership: members share in the prayers and good works of active members throughout the world and gain indulgenes in the saying of the rosary. turn up any monday (except on bank holidays) at the parish conference centre, the mall, newry at 2pm vocations to the diocesan priesthood: anyone interested in joining a discernment group to consider aspects of the diocesan priesthood are invited to contact fr barry matthews, at

. please encourage anyone who you know to contact fr barry for a confidential chat about where they feel god is calling them to. cuan mhuire – café: (200 dublin rd newry) is open monday to saturday, 10am – 2pm. your support greatly helps the work of cuan mhuire. anam cara, armagh , who support bereaved parents, will hold their next parent support evening on wednesday 28th october at 7.30 pm, in the armagh city hotel. this event is free and open to all bereaved parents regardless of the age your child died, the circumstances of their death, or whether their death was recent or not. they also offer an online support service and can be contacted at
